test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

FOUR : TLEI :: CODE : WLVV :: LAST : ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **Alphabets at odd place are coded as the alphabet with opposite positional value -1.

 **Alphabets at even place are coded as the alphabet with opposite positional value.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c378667c7801cf75fcca9cc86b65ed9d3813d76ca4d18ce9df86143558e467c.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3a297b7ff109651df8ef526d00c5a4f15905972b01b4546f419c247f2aeed23.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b58fd01988c5db7e6194f3a98d123b29d46381dd7e6b5eb09499cbdbe5d40482.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
